about: Framework §12.8 ENV-REPORT-1: the permissions PIM Manager DECLARES for each of its identities. The environment report reads what each identity really holds and marks every grant expected / missing / extra against this file. The Graph sets must equal the setup maps in tools/setup/_PimSetupShared.ps1 (Engine and Manager role sets) -- tests/Test-PimEnvironmentReport.ps1 fails if they drift. When SCRIPT-DOC-1 manifests (tools/setup/script-docs/*.doc.json) exist, the report lists them as a second source; this file stays the one the comparison uses.
